project_context.title: Pulse Fitness Pro - MOD Operations Staff Dashboard Restyling Blueprint
project_context.description: Restyling the MOD Operations staff dashboard (at route /bfpo, staff view) to make it visually consistent and indistinguishable from the platform's main Pulse Fitness Pro Operations area.

typography.subtitle: text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-cyan-700 tracking-normal
typography.panel_heading: text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2

layout_grid.kpi_grid: grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3 sm:gap-4 mt-6

header_and_title_block.header_navbar: Black fixed/sticky header (#000000) with 80px height (h-20), white 10% opacity bottom border (`border-b border-white/10`). Left: Pulse Fitness Primary Logo Badge. Right: AccountMenu with role indicator and user profile.
header_and_title_block.title_block: Max width container (`max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 pt-6 pb-2`). Main Title: 'Pulse Fitness Pro · MOD Operations' with bold typography. Subtitle: User greeting 'Welcome back, <userName>' and badge pill 'Pulse Fitness MOD Operations · Global oversight'.

pill_group_navigation.container: Sticky subnav bar directly below header: `bg-slate-50/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/80 py-3 px-4`. Scrollable flex row on mobile with hidden scrollbar (`[&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden`).
pill_group_navigation.tabs: Pill-style rounded buttons (`px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all flex items-center gap-2`). Active: `bg-cyan-600 text-white shadow-sm shadow-cyan-600/20`. Inactive: `text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200/60`.

kpi_stat_cards.grid_layout: 5-column grid (`grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3 sm:gap-4`) matching platform Operations overview.
kpi_stat_cards.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all duration-200 flex flex-col justify-between group
kpi_stat_cards.icon_badge: w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center transition-transform group-hover:scale-105

color_variants.open: icon: text-cyan-600, bg: bg-cyan-50 border border-cyan-100/80
color_variants.urgent: icon: text-red-600, bg: bg-red-50 border border-red-100/80
color_variants.waiting_parts: icon: text-amber-600, bg: bg-amber-50 border border-amber-100/80
color_variants.overdue: icon: text-rose-600, bg: bg-rose-50 border border-rose-100/80
color_variants.sites: icon: text-indigo-600, bg: bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100/80

kpi_stat_cards.value_typography: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-slate-900 tracking-tight mt-3 mb-0.5

attention_panels.cards_wrapper: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm space-y-3
attention_panels.list_item: bg-slate-50/60 hover:bg-slate-100/80 border border-slate-200/60 hover:border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all cursor-pointer group
attention_panels.priority_badges: P1 Critical: bg-red-50 text-red-700 border-red-200 | P2 High: bg-orange-50 text-orange-700 border-orange-200 | P3 Medium: bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 border-amber-200 | P4 Low: bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200
attention_panels.health_indicators: Normal: bg-emerald-500 dot + emerald text | Attention Required: bg-amber-500 dot + amber text | Critical: bg-red-500 dot + red text

footer.placement: Render standard platform Footer or bottom-padded footer with subtle top border (`border-t border-slate-200/80 py-8 text-center text-xs text-slate-400`).

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Update the staffNav sub-header (lines 129-140) to wrap inside a `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8` container. Apply `bg-slate-50/80 border-b border-slate-200/80 py-3` to the subnav wrapper.

3. Style the staffNav pill buttons to match the platform's PillTabBar pattern: `px-4 py-2 rounded-full text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold transition-all flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap`. Set active tab class to `bg-cyan-600 text-white shadow-sm shadow-cyan-600/20` and inactive tab class to `text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200/60`.

5. Update the page title block to use container `max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 pt-6 pb-2`. Update heading to `Pulse Fitness Pro · MOD Operations` with title size `text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight`, user greeting `Welcome back, <userName>`, and cyan sub-heading pill `Pulse Fitness MOD Operations · Global oversight`.

6. Update the KPI tiles grid to 5 columns (`grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3 sm:gap-4`). Use hover-lift effects (`hover:-translate-y-0.5 transition-all`), rounded-2xl cards (`bg-white border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-5`), rounded-xl icon badges, bold 3xl/4xl numbers (`text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-slate-900`), and muted labels (`text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-slate-500`).

7. Restyle the 'Needs attention now' and 'Sites requiring attention' sections with clean card wrappers (`bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-sm`), hover-state list items (`bg-slate-50/60 hover:bg-slate-100/80 border border-slate-200/60 hover:border-slate-300 rounded-xl p-3.5`), priority badges, and health dot status indicators.

9. Update shared primitives (`Card`, `Badge`, `PriorityBadge`, `Btn`) to ensure rounded radii (`rounded-2xl` for cards, `rounded-full` for badges, `rounded-xl` for buttons) and consistent slate border colors (`border-slate-200/80`).
10. Ensure all elements contain proper `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `staff-nav-dashboard`, `staff-kpi-open`, `staff-urgent-<id>`, `staff-attention-<id>`).

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='staff-nav-dashboard', data-testid='staff-kpi-open', data-testid='staff-urgent-item').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain full parity with Pulse Fitness Pro Operations design system.
Prioritize pre-existing tokens and Tailwind utilities over inline custom styles.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons or labels.
Ensure interactive state contrast and smooth micro-interactions across hover, focus, and active states.
Preserve all existing business logic, route handlers, and API queries.
